summary: The dark theme layout displays well overall but suffers from vertical viewport clipping on the incident timeline and low contrast in the glass refraction metadata labels.

issues.title: Timeline container vertical clipping
issues.description: Bottom timeline entry is truncated by the bottom viewport boundary.
issues.evidence: The 17:12 log row at the bottom left is sliced horizontally through the text.
issues.suggestion: Adjust layout spacing or enable internal scrolling within the timeline panel.

issues.title: Low contrast metadata text
issues.description: Secondary captions beneath preview cards have insufficient contrast against the background.
issues.evidence: Labels such as 'material ultrathin' and 'svg-displacement' blend into the dark card surface.
issues.suggestion: Increase opacity or lighten token color for dark mode readability.
